args.body: For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed result. If still open under your valid lease, read the existing bilingual sample and director-barcode-swap-exact-cells.json if committed. If the receipt confirms an isolated grouped failure, add the actual verifier finding to the companion and attribute SKU-level changes to the separate row comparison. If it does not, retain the executed sample and state the verifier evidence limit. Close after evidence readback with a lesson if the sample meets the mission goal. Preserve the existing exact Stream Commerce draft and operator decision. Keep the companion unsent.

description: The catalogue baseline passed all 12 checks. The isolated barcode test stopped during setup because the fixture uses `Barcodes` as its header, so it provided no isolated failure result. The next run changes only two barcode cells and verifies that the existing verifier reports the grouped discrepancy. This gives the operator a clearer delivery sample for the existing Stream Commerce offer. The offer remains pending its exact-draft decision. Five sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Independent review remains required before public deployment.
